blocks.text:
**Duration:** 12 days / 11 nights  
**Dates:** 30 December 2026 – 10 January 2027  
**Format:** group tour

## Prices and hotels

Prices are in US dollars per person for the full programme. SGL means single occupancy, DBL double occupancy and TPL triple occupancy.

| Category | Rio, 4 nights | Iguazu, 3 nights | Amazon, 2 nights | Búzios, 2 nights | SGL | DBL | TPL |
|---|---|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 4* | Windsor Leme | Vivaz Cataratas | Evolucao Ecolodge | Rio Buzios Boutique | $10 351 | $6 401 | $5 846 |
| 5* | Miramar by Windsor | Doubletree by Hilton | Evolucao Ecolodge | Rio Buzios Boutique, sea view | $13 080 | $7 886 | $7 469 |

Hotels may be replaced by other hotels of the same category. International and domestic flights are charged separately. The final price is confirmed when all services are booked and flight fares have been checked.

## Optional excursions on this programme

| Activity | Supplement per person |
|---|---:|
| Bird Park in Iguazu | $50 |
| Macuco Safari | $130 |
| Meeting of the Waters in the Amazon | $150 net |
| Swimming with pink dolphins | $100 net |

The Meeting of the Waters takes place on the way to or from the lodge, during daytime transfers only. New Year's dinner and tickets to a party at a hotel on Copacabana are booked separately; prices on request.

## Transfers in the Amazon

For the included group transfers, you must arrive in Manaus before 16:00 and depart after 14:30. For flights at other times, a private transfer is charged separately. If a traveller in single occupancy takes different flights from the group, a supplement for a private transfer may also apply.
